clusters.name: schema-foundation
clusters.executionModeRationale: Foundational schema must land first and serially. Every downstream story imports from types.ts; parallel execution would force speculative type definitions that could shift as the schema settles.

clusters.name: sync-and-viewer
clusters.executionModeRationale: Stories have disjoint source files but share the __tests__/ directory and the CHANGELOG. Critical ordering constraint: US-002 (sync layer; sync-core.mjs loadOverviewData fallback) MUST land before US-003 (viewer) and US-004 (tests) finalize — viewer fixtures assert end-to-end fallback behavior through the sync layer, so parallel execution risks flaky test failures whenever US-002 lands after US-003. Recommend single impl member sequencing US-002 → US-003 → US-006 → US-004 inside this cluster; do NOT parallelize across members.

clusters.name: docs-and-version
clusters.executionModeRationale: Runs last in PR #1 because the version bump and CHANGELOG entry summarize what landed.

clusters.name: codexu-rewrite
clusters.executionModeRationale: PR #2 in the codexu repo runs only after PR #1 is merged to ai-developer-toolkit main so the viewer can already read the new shape via the v2.3.0 alias. Three small docs/data edits with no file overlap; a single member sequences them.

clusters.name: memory-updates
clusters.executionModeRationale: Operator-local; runs last because it documents the conventions just established in PR #1 + PR #2.
